description:
Start a dry run at the price handinloop_quote_plan_dry_run quoted. THIS COSTS: the quoted credits are charged, each charged sample just before it is read (a sample that fails is not charged), and the free pages it uses are counted against the month and never given back. Applies nothing to the organisation.

Refused, with nothing made, when the quote has moved since (another run took the free pages, or the plan changed): the error carries the new quote; confirm it and run again.

The run is read in the background: poll handinloop_get_plan_dry_run. The run, its copies of the samples and its answer key are deleted 30 days after it is made.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Args: as handinloop_quote_plan_dry_run, plus expected_credits and expected_free_pages as quoted.

Returns: { dry_run_id, plan_id, plan_revision, status, samples, credits, free_pages, expires_at, next_step }

answer_key.description: The samples' completed examples as the pilot ground-truth CSV (wide or long, rules included): a source_ref column naming each sample, and columns of the plan's task types' fields

expected_free_pages.description: The free pages you were quoted

source_ref.description: The document's name in the answer key, unique in the run

task_type.description: The plan's task type it runs under; optional when the plan has one

name: handinloop_run_plan_dry_run
title: Run a Plan Dry Run
